source: Majesty: The Fantasy Kingdom Sim wiki (majesty.fandom.com), Sovereign Spells and temple pages, Oct 2026. A game day is about 60 s, so 'half a day' is about 30 s. The player pays the cost in gold each cast.

spells.name: Farseeing
spells.effect: Reveal a circle of unexplored map

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.effect: Target can't be attacked for 5 s

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.effect: 16-35 damage to a unit or building (any side)

spells.name: Anti-magic Shield
spells.effect: Own hero's resist set to 90 for a third of a day

spells.name: Lightning Storm
spells.effect: 8-25 damage every 0.5 s for 2.5 s to enemies in an area

spells.name: Super Charge
spells.effect: Doubles Wizards' Guild spell range for 30 s

spells.name: Healing
spells.effect: Restore 100 HP

spells.name: Blessing
spells.effect: Half a day: melee +10, ranged +10, parry +15, dodge +15

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.effect: Revive a dead hero at their guild

spells.name: Stone Skin
spells.effect: Armour +6 for half a day

spells.name: Vigilance
spells.effect: 30 s: +10 to will, melee, ranged, parry, dodge; weapon damage +6; faster attack and move

spells.name: Petrify
spells.effect: Freeze target 19 s (halved on a resist roll)

spells.name: Wither
spells.effect: Half a day: strength -10, much slower move and attack

spells.name: Animate Bones
spells.effect: Give the target a skeleton follower

spells.name: Reanimate
spells.effect: Revive a dead hero where they fell

spells.name: Healing
spells.effect: Restore 100 HP (twice Agrela's price)

spells.name: Illusionary Hero
spells.effect: Decoy copy of a hero that draws enemies and bleeds 1 HP per 0.5 s

spells.name: Vines
spells.effect: Root target 14 s (halved on a strength roll)

spells.name: Fire Strike
spells.effect: 2-15 damage to a unit

spells.name: Sun Scorch
spells.effect: 10-28 damage to all visible enemies in an area

spells.name: Winged Feet
spells.effect: Large speed boost for 30 s

spells.name: Wind Storm
spells.effect: 10-24 damage for ~4 s and throws enemies a long way in a random direction

spells.name: Rage of Krolm
spells.effect: Guild power: all heroes faster and stronger for a while

spells.name: Call to Arms
spells.effect: Guild power: teleport all its heroes home

spells.name: Move Camp
spells.effect: Guild power: relocate the guild building

spells.name: Extort
spells.effect: Guild power: collect all taxes now; the guild keeps ~35%

spells.name: Market Day
spells.effect: Building power: ~2x revenue now, then shut for 45 s (no sales, no income)

spells.name: Enchant Tower
spells.effect: Tower gains a ~10 damage magic attack for a time (needs Wizards' Guild L2)

spells.name: Change of Heart
spells.effect: Fleeing hero returns to fight; any other hero flees

spells.name: Frost Field
spells.effect: Periodic frost damage to enemies near the target

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.effect: 110-220 damage to buildings in range over 5 s

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.effect: ~30-40 damage jumping between nearby enemies

spells.name: Gate
spells.effect: Teleport heroes near the Abode to a target spot

spells.name: Dismiss
spells.effect: Push a unit to the edge of the map
